page.overview:
Who is Abraham Cornelius?

Through a year of work, Weapon Plus managed to subject it to the same process that created Wolverine, transforming their captive into Predator X. When United States Army General Charlotte Pett arrived at Virginia Weapon Plus facility with an inspection, Cornelius presented her Predator X as the result of their work.

When others of its species attacked Earth, Cornelius deployed Predator X on a mission to take out Kraven the Hunter, who was assisting the Predators with their invasion. Predator X succeeded in its mission, but immediately afterwards General ordered Cornelius to decommission it, which Cornelius refused, revealing that he had been enhanced with metals claws himself.
